Delete from DB

deleteData.Rd

Delete from DB

Usage

deleteData(conn, table, var, condition, operation = "=")

Arguments

conn

Connection

table

Fully qualified table name

var

Variable used to identify row

condition

Condition to delete

operation

Operation

This function has been designed to be more restrictive since deleting is less common and more destructive. If you want to delete multiple rows, paste lookup values in the condition attribute or use functional

Value

The number of rows affected
